<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
<title>OD's Luxury Empire &amp; Spa | Demonstration Preview</title>
<style>
:root{--plum:#46283F;--deep:#2A1626;--gold:#D4A53A;--gold2:#E8C976;--cream:#F8F1E6;--ink:#2A1626;--mut:#6a5463;--line:#e6d9c7;--wa:#25D366}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:Carlito,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-size:17px;line-height:1.5}
h1,h2,h3,.serif{font-family:FreeSerif,Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1140px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px}
.pv{background:var(--gold);color:var(--deep);text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;padding:8px 14px;letter-spacing:.03em}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:var(--plum);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:64px}
header img{height:42px;width:auto}
nav{display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:center}
nav a{text-decoration:none;color:#f1e6ee;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
nav a:hover{color:var(--gold2)}
.btn{display:inline-block;border:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:700;border-radius:40px;padding:13px 24px;text-decoration:none;text-align:center}
.b-wa{background:var(--wa);color:#06361a}
.b-gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--deep)}
.b-out{border:2px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold2);background:transparent;padding:11px 24px}
.burger{display:none;background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font-size:28px;cursor:pointer}
@media(max-width:820px){nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:64px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--plum);flex-direction:column;padding:16px 22px 22px;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}nav.open{display:flex}.burger{display:block}}
.hero{position:relative;background:var(--deep);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.hero .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center 30%/cover;opacity:.35}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;padding-top:60px;padding-bottom:64px}
.kick{color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:.28em;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.hero h1{font-size:50px;line-height:1.08;margin:12px 0 16px}
.hero h1 em{color:var(--gold2)}
.hero p{font-size:19px;color:#f0e4ee;max-width:520px;margin-bottom:26px}
.hero .cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero .card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(232,201,118,.4);border-radius:18px;padding:22px;text-align:center;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.hero .card img{width:170px;border-radius:14px}
.hero .card p{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:16px}
@media(max-width:820px){.hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center}.hero h1{font-size:36px}.hero p{margin-inline:auto}.hero .cta{justify-content:center}}
.strip{background:var(--plum);color:#fff}
.strip .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);text-align:center;padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:18px;gap:8px}
.strip b{display:block;font:700 26px FreeSerif,Georgia,serif;color:var(--gold2)}
.strip span{font-size:14px;color:#e7d8e3}
@media(max-width:600px){.strip .wrap{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);row-gap:14px}}
section{padding:60px 0}
.eyebrow{color:#8A6508;letter-spacing:.26em;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;text-align:center}
h2{font-size:36px;text-align:center;color:var(--plum);margin:8px 0 6px}
.sub{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);max-width:620px;margin:0 auto 26px}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:26px}
.tab{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:30px;padding:9px 18px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;color:var(--plum);cursor:pointer}
.tab.on{background:var(--plum);color:#fff;border-color:var(--plum)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:16px}
.card2{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;border-top:4px solid var(--gold);padding:22px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(70,40,63,.09);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.card2[hidden]{display:none}
.card2 small{color:#8A6508;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:12px}
.card2 h3{font-size:23px;color:var(--plum);margin:4px 0 6px}
.card2 p{color:var(--mut);font-size:16px;flex:1}
.card2 .row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.card2 .btn{padding:9px 16px;font-size:15px}
.b-dark{background:var(--plum);color:#fff}
.band{background:var(--deep);color:#fff}
.band h2{color:var(--gold2)}.band .sub{color:#d9c8d4}.band .eyebrow{color:var(--gold2)}
.pk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:16px}
.pkc{background:#3a2035;border:1px solid rgba(232,201,118,.35);border-radius:16px;padding:26px}
.pkc h3{color:var(--gold2);font-size:25px}
.pkc ul{margin:12px 0 18px 18px;color:#e6d6e1}
.pkc .pr{font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:15px;opacity:.85}
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}
.gal button{border:0;padding:0;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;background:none}
.gal img{width:100%;height:260px;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s}
.gal button:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.book{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(70,40,63,.1)}
label{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--plum);margin:14px 0 5px}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;background:#fffdf9;color:var(--ink)}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
@media(max-width:520px){.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.note{font-size:14px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:12px}
details{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:10px}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:var(--plum)}
details p{margin-top:8px;color:var(--mut)}
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}
.cb{background:#3a2035;border-radius:16px;padding:22px}
.cb small{color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.cb p{margin-top:6px;font-size:18px}
footer{background:#160c14;color:#bfa9b9;text-align:center;font-size:14px;padding:26px 18px}
footer b{color:var(--gold2)}
.fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:60;background:var(--wa);color:#06361a;font-weight:700;border-radius:40px;padding:13px 20px;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,8,18,.72);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:100;padding:18px}
.modal.on{display:flex}
.mbox{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;max-width:480px;width:100%;padding:26px;position:relative;max-height:90vh;overflow:auto}
.mbox h3{font-size:28px;color:var(--plum)}
.mbox p{color:var(--mut);margin:10px 0 18px}
.x{position:absolute;right:14px;top:10px;border:0;background:none;font-size:30px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--plum)}
.lb img{max-width:94vw;max-height:86vh;border-radius:12px}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:.6s}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
</style></head><body>
<div class="pv">DEMONSTRATION PREVIEW by Healingzion Management Ventures. Prices, packages and details are placeholders until OD's Luxury Empire &amp; Spa approves.</div>
<header><div class="wrap"><a href="#top"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="OD's Luxury Empire &amp; Spa"></a>
<button class="burger" id="bg" aria-label="Menu">&#9776;</button>
<nav id="nv"><a href="#services">Services</a><a href="#packages">Packages</a><a href="#gallery">Gallery</a><a href="#book">Book</a><a href="#faq">FAQ</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a><a class="btn b-gold" href="#book" style="padding:9px 18px">Book now</a></nav></div></header>
<div class="hero" id="top"><div class="bg"></div><div class="wrap">
<div><div class="kick">LUXURY SPA · SALON · BARBERSHOP · EFFURUN, WARRI</div>
<h1>Look good. Feel <em>renewed.</em> Book in seconds.</h1>
<p>Skin clinic, spa and massage, barbing, hair, lashes and nails, all under one roof. Pick a service and send your booking straight to us on WhatsApp.</p>
<div class="cta"><a class="btn b-wa" href="#book">Book on WhatsApp</a><a class="btn b-out" href="#services">See services</a></div></div>
<div class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="OD's logo"><p>Uti, off PTI Road, Effurun<br>Warri, Delta State</p></div>
</div></div>
<div class="strip"><div class="wrap"><div><b>5.0 ★</b><span>Google rating</span></div><div><b>8.3K</b><span>Instagram followers</span></div><div><b>6</b><span>Services in one place</span></div><div><b>1 tap</b><span>WhatsApp booking</span></div></div></div>

<section id="services"><div class="wrap">
<div class="eyebrow">WHAT WE DO</div><h2>Our Services</h2><p class="sub">Choose a category, open a service and book it in a few taps.</p>
<div class="tabs" id="tabs"><button class="tab on" data-f="all">All</button><button class="tab" data-f="spa">Spa &amp; Skin</button><button class="tab" data-f="beauty">Hair &amp; Beauty</button><button class="tab" data-f="barb">Barbing</button></div>
<div class="grid" id="sg"></div></div></section>

<section class="band" id="packages"><div class="wrap">
<div class="eyebrow">SAMPLE PACKAGES</div><h2>Treat yourself to the best</h2><p class="sub">Example bundles to show how packages could look. OD's would set the real contents and prices.</p>
<div class="pk">
<div class="pkc"><h3>Glow Package</h3><div class="pr">Price to be confirmed by OD's</div><ul><li>Facial treatment</li><li>Skin consultation</li><li>Relaxing finish</li></ul><button class="btn b-gold" data-book="Skin Clinic">Book this</button></div>
<div class="pkc"><h3>Relax Package</h3><div class="pr">Price to be confirmed by OD's</div><ul><li>Body massage</li><li>Sauna session</li><li>Spa finish</li></ul><button class="btn b-gold" data-book="Spa &amp; Massage">Book this</button></div>
<div class="pkc"><h3>Groom Package</h3><div class="pr">Price to be confirmed by OD's</div><ul><li>Fresh cut and fade</li><li>Clean lineup</li><li>Quick facial</li></ul><button class="btn b-gold" data-book="Barbing">Book this</button></div>
</div></div></section>

<section id="gallery"><div class="wrap">
<div class="eyebrow">THE SPACE</div><h2>Step inside OD's</h2><p class="sub">Tap a photo to enlarge it. These are sample photos. The final site would use OD's own professional photos.</p>
<div class="gal"><button data-lb><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="OD's building"></button><button data-lb><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Inside OD's"></button><button data-lb><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="OD's at night"></button></div></div></section>

<section class="band" id="book"><div class="wrap">
<div class="eyebrow">BOOK ONLINE</div><h2>Request your appointment</h2><p class="sub">Fill this in and it opens WhatsApp with your request ready to send. OD's confirms your time by reply.</p>
<form class="book" id="bf" style="color:var(--ink)">
<label>Your name</label><input id="n" required placeholder="e.g. Ada">
<div class="two"><div><label>Service</label><select id="s"></select></div><div><label>Preferred date</label><input id="d" type="date" required></div></div>
<div class="two"><div><label>Preferred time</label><input id="t" type="time" required></div><div><label>Your phone</label><input id="p" type="tel" placeholder="optional"></div></div>
<label>Note (optional)</label><textarea id="m" rows="3" placeholder="Anything we should know?"></textarea>
<button class="btn b-wa" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px" type="submit">Send booking on WhatsApp</button>
<p class="note">Demo: the button opens WhatsApp with your request prepared. Nothing is sent until you press send in WhatsApp.</p></form></div></section>

<section id="faq"><div class="wrap" style="max-width:780px"><div class="eyebrow">QUESTIONS</div><h2>Good to know</h2><div style="height:22px"></div>
<details><summary>How do I book?</summary><p>Use the booking form above. It opens WhatsApp with your request ready, and we reply to confirm your time.</p></details>
<details><summary>Where are you?</summary><p>30A Governor Avenue, Okoribi II, Uti, off PTI Road, Effurun, Warri, Delta State.</p></details>
<details><summary>What are your opening hours?</summary><p>Google shows the spa closing at 6 pm. Final opening days and hours will be confirmed by OD's.</p></details>
<details><summary>How much do services cost?</summary><p>Prices are placeholders in this preview. OD's would add its real price list.</p></details>
<details><summary>Do you take walk-ins?</summary><p>To be confirmed by OD's. Booking ahead is the best way to avoid waiting.</p></details>
</div></section>

<section class="band" id="contact"><div class="wrap"><div class="eyebrow">FIND US</div><h2>Visit or contact OD's</h2><div style="height:22px"></div>
<div class="contact">
<div class="cb"><small>ADDRESS</small><p>30A Governor Avenue, Okoribi II, Uti, off PTI Road, Effurun, Warri, Delta State</p></div>
<div class="cb"><small>CALL / WHATSAPP</small><p><a href="tel:+2349131210027">0913 121 0027</a><br><a href="tel:+2348151499061">0815 149 9061</a></p></div>
<div class="cb"><small>FOLLOW</small><p>Instagram: @o.ds_luxury_empire_spa<br>Facebook: O.D's Luxury Empire&amp;Spa</p></div>
</div></div></section>
<footer>© OD's Luxury Empire &amp; Spa. This is a <b>demonstration preview</b> made by Healingzion Management Ventures · healingzion.net</footer>
<a class="fab" href="#book">WhatsApp booking</a>

<div class="modal" id="m1"><div class="mbox"><button class="x" data-close>&times;</button><small id="mc" style="color:#8A6508;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em"></small><h3 id="mt"></h3><p id="md"></p><button class="btn b-wa" id="mb">Book this service</button></div></div>
<div class="modal lb" id="m2"><button class="x" data-close style="color:#fff;font-size:38px">&times;</button><img id="li" alt=""></div>

<script>
var WA="2349131210027";
var S=[
["Skin Clinic","spa","Facials and skin care","Professional facial treatments and skin care to help your skin look fresh and healthy."],
["Spa & Massage","spa","Relax and unwind","Body massage, sauna and spa treatments in a calm, luxurious space."],
["Barbing Salon","barb","Cuts, fades, lineups","Clean cuts, sharp fades and neat lineups from skilled barbers."],
["Hair Dressing","beauty","Braids and styling","Hair styling and braiding, including neat, lightweight, long-lasting styles."],
["Lash Extension","beauty","Soft, full lashes","Lash extensions for a fuller, more defined eye look."],
["Nails","beauty","Manicure and pedicure","Neat manicure and pedicure finishes for hands and feet."]];
var g=document.getElementById('sg'),sel=document.getElementById('s');
S.forEach(function(x,i){
 var c=document.createElement('div');c.className='card2 rv';c.dataset.c=x[1];
 c.innerHTML='<small>'+(x[1]=='spa'?'SPA & SKIN':x[1]=='barb'?'BARBING':'HAIR & BEAUTY')+'</small><h3>'+x[0]+'</h3><p>'+x[2]+'. Price on request.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn b-dark" data-i="'+i+'">Details</button><button class="btn b-gold" data-book="'+x[0]+'">Book</button></div>';
 g.appendChild(c);
 var o=document.createElement('option');o.textContent=x[0];sel.appendChild(o);
});
document.getElementById('tabs').onclick=function(e){var b=e.target.closest('.tab');if(!b)return;
 document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(t){t.classList.toggle('on',t==b)});
 document.querySelectorAll('.card2').forEach(function(c){c.hidden=!(b.dataset.f=='all'||c.dataset.c==b.dataset.f)});};
var m1=document.getElementById('m1'),m2=document.getElementById('m2'),cur="";
function openBook(n){sel.value=n;m1.classList.remove('on');document.getElementById('book').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
 var d=e.target.closest('[data-i]');
 if(d){var x=S[d.dataset.i];cur=x[0];document.getElementById('mc').textContent='SERVICE';document.getElementById('mt').textContent=x[0];document.getElementById('md').textContent=x[3]+' Price: to be confirmed by OD\'s.';m1.classList.add('on');return}
 var b=e.target.closest('[data-book]');if(b){openBook(b.dataset.book.replace('&amp;','&'));return}
 var l=e.target.closest('[data-lb]');if(l){document.getElementById('li').src=l.querySelector('img').src;m2.classList.add('on');return}
 if(e.target.closest('[data-close]')||e.target==m1||e.target==m2){m1.classList.remove('on');m2.classList.remove('on')}
});
document.getElementById('mb').onclick=function(){openBook(cur)};
document.getElementById('bg').onclick=function(){document.getElementById('nv').classList.toggle('open')};
document.getElementById('nv').onclick=function(){this.classList.remove('open')};
var dt=document.getElementById('d');dt.min=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
document.getElementById('bf').onsubmit=function(e){e.preventDefault();
 var t="Hello OD's Luxury Empire & Spa, I would like to book.\nName: "+n.value+"\nService: "+sel.value+"\nDate: "+dt.value+"\nTime: "+document.getElementById('t').value+(p.value?"\nPhone: "+p.value:"")+(m.value?"\nNote: "+m.value:"");
 window.open("https://wa.me/"+WA+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(t),"_blank");};
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(x){if(x.isIntersecting){x.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(x.target)}})},{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv,.pkc,.cb').forEach(function(x){x.classList.add('rv');io.observe(x)});
</script></body></html>
